theorems.name: Submission.lcn_mult_mul_orient_apply_integrableOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x α) (R.carrier ∩ K) μHE[n]
